title: たゆまぬ気魄【バトルクライ】

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm walking around the academy after class has let out…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello there, Trainer. Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm on my way to the cafeteria for a costume party.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I wanted to do something from a fantasy world, so I decided to dress up as a cleric.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Grass, you look wonderful! It suits you so well!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my… Hehe, thank you. I'm glad that I could do this costume justice.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text: And being a cleric with healing powers is just perfect for you, too!
choice_data_list: You do have that calming vibe about you.
You do have that calming vibe about you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, I'm honored…

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Yes, but I don't just mean her vibe. There was this one time, back when we first enrolled…

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Oh, this is no good… No matter how hard I train, I keep falling behind…

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text: The standards at Tracen really are crazy high…

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text: You're right… It's like there's no point in even trying anymore.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! You're gonna do more, Grass?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But you just finished healing from your last injury. I know tryouts are coming up, but if you push yourself too hard…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I'm doing the rest of today's training in the pool, to avoid straining my body too much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Besides…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have to do everything I possibly can. I don't want to have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If I tread too gingerly around minor setbacks, I will never achieve the growth I desire.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Okay! Then I won't lose, either! Time t'get serious!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. ♪ Why don't you join me for that swim, then?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Whenever we're about to lose heart… we remember those words and press on!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text: Your magical words of courage healed us, in a way. You gave us the courage we lost!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I gave you… courage?
choice_data_list: Now that does sound like your kind of magic.
Now that does sound like your kind of magic.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: While I'm grateful to my fans for their support… I always run purely for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …I never thought my efforts would inspire someone else.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I suppose a cleric's healing magic can come in many forms.
choice_data_list: You'll have to run your best to inspire the rest.
You should use your magic on me next time.
You should use your magic on me next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I suppose a cleric's healing magic can come in many forms.
choice_data_list: You'll have to run your best to inspire the rest.
You should use your magic on me next time.
You should use your magic on me next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. In fact, the thought is raising my spirits already. It makes me want to start running at once.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: As luck would have it, the party won't start for a little while yet. A quick run shouldn't pose a problem.

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text: U-um! May we join you? We promise we won't get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course. Just to be clear, I won't be holding back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's stride is more powerful than ever after making this new discovery.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No problem at all. Let's see… does it go like this?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Swoosh! ♪ I cast Heal!

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Us, too, please!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Dear me. Then I'll cast magic on all of you at once… Nature's Blessing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch Grass Wonder cast her magic, just seeing the smile on her face is uplifting on its own.
